## XRD-Scherrer v1.2.0

Offline single-file HTML tool for XRD coherently diffracting domain-size analysis, multi-peak nonlinear Pseudo-Voigt deconvolution, reciprocal-space spherical crystallite size distribution (CSD) inversion, and isotropic Williamson–Hall regression.

### Download

Download **XRD-Scherrer-v1.2.0.html** from Assets and open it directly in your browser. It is a self-contained zero-dependency application with no installation or network requirement. `SHA256SUMS.txt` verifies the HTML; the automatically generated Source code archives are optional.

### Changes

- **Multi-peak nonlinear deconvolution (Tab ②):** From-scratch analytic-Jacobian, multi-start, box-constrained Levenberg–Marquardt fitter supporting 1–6 overlapping Pseudo-Voigt / Gaussian / Lorentzian sub-peaks with joint linear or SNIP baseline.
  - Presets: `PtCo L1₀ (220)+(202)` (64°–75°, initial 68.45°/70.46°), `PtCo L1₀ (200)+(002)` (44°–52°), `Bimodal (111) small+large` (co-centered narrow+broad), and smoothed negative second-derivative auto peak seeding.
  - Reports per-sub-peak 2θ, height, FWHM, integral breadth β, η, net area Aₖ, area/volume fraction, individual Scherrer Dₖ, fit quality (R², Rwp, RMSE), sub-peak + residual plots, explicit comparison of **total fitted area ΣAₖ vs fitted-baseline numerical area vs traditional endpoint-baseline area**, and inferred tetragonal lattice parameters **a, c, c/a**.
- **PtCo (220)+(202) & L1₀ Williamson–Hall upgrades:**
  - Tab ① `PtCo empirical (220)` mode now defaults to 64°–75° `(220)+(202)` 2-peak deconvolution (with a legacy single-peak SNIP toggle for comparison).
  - Tab ③ Multi-peak + Williamson–Hall supports per-row single/doublet deconvolution and adds `+ Load PtCo L1₀ (5 peaks)` extracting `(111)`, `(200)`, `(002)`, `(220)`, and `(202)`.
- **Crystallite Size Distribution (CSD) inversion (Tab ②):**
  - Isolates any fitted sub-peak (subtracting fitted baseline and neighboring overlapping peaks, or defaulting to `Composite` for co-centered bimodal peaks), maps to reciprocal space s = 2sinθ/λ − s₀, and inverts exact spherical crystallite diffraction kernels I_S(s; D) (with Gaussian/Cauchy instrumental convolution) via volume/area-hybrid second-order Tikhonov-NNLS.
  - Outputs continuous f_V(D) and f_N(D) (PDF/CDF toggle, bimodal mode detection), ⟨D⟩N ± σN, ⟨D⟩A = ⟨D³⟩/⟨D²⟩, ⟨D⟩V, and D10/D50/D90, plus `Download CSD CSV`.
  - Cross-checked against **de Keijser (1982)** Voigt decomposition + **Krill–Birringer / Langford–Louër–Scardi** lognormal analysis, honestly suppressing variance for near-Gaussian profiles (⟨L⟩V/⟨L⟩A ≤ 9/8).
- **UX & validation:** Drag-to-zoom / double-click-reset main chart with active region shading, polydisperse/bimodal PtCo L1₀ demo dataset, EN / 中文 toggle, and expanded jsdom regression tests.

### Validation and interpretation

CI (`Validate and release`) runs `npm ci && npm test` covering parsing, analytic Gaussian Scherrer width, Gaussian/Cauchy instrument corrections, `(220)+(202)` doublet area recovery vs endpoint underestimation, tetragonal `a/c/c/a`, lognormal & bimodal spherical NNLS CSD recovery, instrument-convolved CSD, Krill–Birringer Gaussian variance suppression, PtCo L1₀ 5-peak W–H, bilingual toggle, CSD CSV export, and input invalidation.

**Notes:** Kα₂ stripping is not implemented (use monochromated or externally corrected data). Scherrer domain size and spherical CSD assume negligible microstrain/faulting in the isolated reflection.
